mandatoryFindings.category: Initial authorization provenance/complete actual actor roster
locations: install-cli.py:execute allowed scope and forbidden derived candidate fields
mandatoryFindings.problem: Initial installation authorization sets typedActorRosterComplete:true but derives only contract known11 plus the actual installer designation. The installer rejects caller typedPriorActors/evidence maps and has no narrow separately completed outside/install-scope/owner/source-reader fact input. Therefore already-known actual outside actors cannot enter this first immutable control through any reviewed producer path.
mandatoryFindings.impact: The first authorization is labelled complete while those actual writers/helpers are omitted. Adding them to a later setup control before the negative observation does not retroactively complete or truthfully scope the immutable initial authorization. The inherited requirement covers all actual known outside/install-scope actors, not merely known11+installer or first qualifying observation.
mandatoryFindings.counterexampleAndSourceEvidence: Exact installer code produces known11+installer; allowed scope/candidate graph contains no actualPriorActors fact channel. Independent current composition retained synthetic outside900090 and verifier900101 only when added through later JSrequest/setup author; the same first source-produced INSTALL state preceded those additions. This supports the later carrier mechanism while exposing the missing initial channel. No additional target case or real actors were invented.
mandatoryFindings.minimumCorrection: Add one bounded narrow actual outside/helper fact input to the concrete installation scope/CLI, with exact separately captured status/tool provenance, strict fields and approved evidence-carrier binding; derive/validate and incrementally union those facts with known11 and the actual pending installer before pure preflight and before declaring initial roster complete/writing. Continue forbidding root-built code/binary/input/member/derived actor maps. Preserve initial installer pendingNull and no self/future completion. Correct in an immutable successor, then new exact independent reviews/root adoption; do not silently reinterpret Complete as a subset.
